failedAssertions.reason: The dedicated blocked section stayed hidden in overview even though six visible rows were labeled 'At risk', so the canonical blocked callout was absent.
Blocked visibility never responded to active subsets because the blocked section remained hidden in overview, goal scope, department scope, and combined filtered states.
Goal scope updated summary, table, and scope indicator together, but the blocked section did not update to that subset and stayed hidden despite 'At risk' rows within goal 2.

Department scope + search + reset returned summary and table to overview, but the blocked section never surfaced either before or after reset even though overview still contained visible 'At risk' rows.

Refreshing during a narrowed state left an incoherent post-refresh UI: the loading message persisted over loaded content, scope text remained while scope visibility was false, and the narrowed filters stayed active.

On repeated fresh opens, the browser-rendered dashboard content was already visible in the first captured frame, so the app did not present an observable loading-only state before summary/goals/controls/table content appeared.

Browser history was not a no-op: Back from the dashboard returned to about:blank before Forward restored the dashboard, so browser navigation did alter page state instead of remaining inert within the single-page app.

Stale-goal semantics were not fully unambiguous: in the custom-data run the page-level freshness badge read 'Live · current (0d old)' while the first goal card simultaneously showed 'Stale (> 7d)', creating conflicting visible recency signals on the same screen.

During a mocked refresh failure, the page collapsed from the normal top-to-bottom header/summary/goals/controls/detail reading order to only the refresh button plus retry surface, so the reading order was not preserved across load transitions.
Goal cards showed labels, progress, and stale signals, but they never surfaced blocked counts or blocked-owner names even though six visible rows were marked 'At risk'.
Freshness did not reliably reflect sheet-update recency: the header badge stayed at 'Live · update date unavailable' even though rows had dated updates and goal cards were marked stale.

blockedAssertions.blockedBy: The current dataset never produced a fully complete goal card, so there was no qualifying complete/no-blocked goal to verify this assertion against.

I could validate stale goal treatment and scoped dimming separately, but I could not produce a browser state where a non-selected dimmed card also remained stale instead of becoming an empty-state card, so this exact coexistence case was not directly testable in the current implementation.

appliedUpdates.description: Added a Browser UI flow-validator guidance section documenting session isolation, shared server usage, evidence expectations, and the max-concurrency constraint of 2.
Created .factory/validation/leadership-ui/user-testing/flows plus mission evidence directories so browser subagents could write isolated reports and screenshots.
